# `hk util detect-private-key`

- **Usage:** `hk util detect-private-key <FILES>…`
- **Effect:** read-only

Detect private keys in files

## Arguments

- **`<FILES>…`** — Files to check

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

Check the supplied files for recognized private-key markers.

```sh
hk util detect-private-key config/example.env
```
